Great question! Let me break down the two best value options for you:
ROW 94 Bourbon ($24.99) is a 94-proof Kentucky Straight Bourbon aged for at least four years with a mash bill of 70% corn and 21% rye. You'll get rich notes of vanilla and toffee upfront, hints of crisp green apple, and a smooth finish with honey and tobacco. It's bolder at 94 proof and delivers deep complexity from those charred oak barrels.
Redemption Straight Bourbon ($28.99) is a 96-proof (48% ABV) bourbon with 75% corn and 21% rye, aged about two and a half years. It has a sweeter, more caramel-forward palate with notes of hazelnut, caramel, nectarine, and charred oak, plus a medium finish with a hint of spice. This one earned a Gold Medal and 91 points in Los Angeles.
For everyday use and value, I'd recommend ROW 94 — you're getting:
Longer aging (4+ years vs. 2.5 years) for more depth
$4 less per bottle, which adds up over time
Classic bourbon profile that's versatile for sipping or mixing
The Redemption is excellent too, especially if you prefer a sweeter, caramel-heavy profile. But for your needs — everyday drinking with great value — the ROW 94 gives you more bourbon for your money.
